\section*{Chapter 22 - Graph Foundations}


\subsection*{Purpose}
\item Provide the mathematical foundations behind the Semantic Evidence Graph (SEG).
\item Describe node/edge semantics, hypergraph extensions, and validation routines that keep the graph consistent.
\item Offer runnable commands to verify tag coverage and validate graph integrity.

\subsection*{Graph Structure}

SEG is modeled as a labeled multigraph with optional hyperedges:

\textbf{Formal Definition:}
``\texttt{
G = (V, E, τ\_TT, τ\_VT, θ, σ, ε)

Where:
\item V = C ∪ S ∪ D ∪ A (Claims, Sources, Derivations, Agents)
\item E ⊆ V × V × EdgeTypes (Directed edges with types)
\item τ\_TT: V ∪ E → Timestamps (Transaction time)
\item τ\_VT: V → Intervals (Valid time)
\item θ: V → Content (Node content function)
\item σ: E → [0, 1] (Edge strength function)
\item ε: C → ℝ\textasciicircum{}d (Claim embedding function)
}`\texttt{

\textbf{Properties (Axioms):}
\item \textbf{A1 (Acyclicity):} G has no directed cycles (is a DAG for derivations)
\item \textbf{A2 (Anchoring):} Every claim has at least one source anchor
\item \textbf{A3 (Temporal Consistency):} Valid time intervals respect causality
\item \textbf{A4 (Contradiction Resolution):} Contradicting claims trigger remediation

\textbf{Node Types:}

\textbf{1. Claim (C):}
\item Factual assertion (evidence)
\item Fields: }content\texttt{, }confidence\texttt{, }created\_at\texttt{, }valid\_from\texttt{, }valid\_to\texttt{
\item Example: "OAuth2 uses JWT tokens"
\item Embedding: }ε(c) ∈ ℝ\textasciicircum{}d\texttt{ for semantic similarity

\textbf{2. Source (S):}
\item Origin of evidence
\item Fields: }vif\_id\texttt{, }document\_path\texttt{, }creator\texttt{
\item Example: VIF witness, document, user input
\item Authority: Tier A/B/C classification

\textbf{3. Derivation (D):}
\item How claim was derived
\item Fields: }plan\_id\texttt{, }inputs\texttt{, }outputs\texttt{, }reasoning\texttt{
\item Example: APOE execution trace, inference chain
\item Confidence: Propagated from inputs

\textbf{4. Agent (A):}
\item Who/what created claim
\item Fields: }agent\_type\texttt{, }model\_id\texttt{, }user\_id\texttt{
\item Example: Human user, AI model, system component
\item Trust: Authority-weighted scoring

\textbf{Edge Types:}

\textbf{1. supports:}
\item Evidence backs up claim
\item Direction: Source S → supports → Claim C
\item Strength: }σ(supports) ∈ [0, 1]\texttt{ (evidence strength)
\item Formula: }σ = authority(source) * relevance(source, claim)\texttt{

\textbf{2. contradicts:}
\item Evidence conflicts with claim
\item Direction: Claim C1 ← contradicts → Claim C2
\item Strength: }σ(contradicts) = semantic\_similarity(C1, C2)\texttt{
\item Detection: Embedding distance < threshold AND stance mismatch

\textbf{3. derives:}
\item Claim produced from others
\item Direction: Derivation D → derives → Claim C
\item Strength: }σ(derives) = confidence(derivation)\texttt{
\item Confidence propagation: }confidence(C) = f(confidence(inputs))\texttt{

\textbf{4. witnesses:}
\item VIF records claim
\item Direction: Source (VIF) → witnesses → Claim
\item Strength: }σ(witnesses) = vif\_confidence\texttt{
\item Audit trail: Links to VIF witness envelope

\textbf{5. cites:}
\item Reference to source
\item Direction: Claim → cites → Source
\item Strength: }σ(cites) = 1.0\texttt{ (always full strength)
\item Purpose: Citation tracking

\textbf{Hyperedges:}
\item Enable relationships involving more than two nodes
\item Example: Claim C supported by multiple anchors simultaneously
\item Structure: }H = (V\_H, E\_H)\texttt{ where }V\_H ⊆ V\texttt{ and }E\_H\texttt{ connects all nodes in }V\_H\texttt{
\item Use case: Multi-source evidence aggregation

\textbf{Storage:}
\item Adjacency lists stored in CMC (bitemporal)
\item Indexes maintained for fast retrieval:
  - By tag (NL tag index)
  - By time (transaction time, valid time)
  - By persona (agent attribution)
  - By confidence (confidence-weighted traversal)

\subsection*{Scoring \& Consistency}

\textbf{Edge Weight Calculation:}

Edge weights reflect evidence strength and are computed as:

\textbf{Supports Edge:}
}`\texttt{
σ(supports) = authority(source) × relevance(source, claim)
}`\texttt{
Where:
\item }authority(source)\texttt{: Tier A=1.0, Tier B=0.75, Tier C=0.50
\item }relevance(source, claim)\texttt{: Semantic similarity (cosine distance)

\textbf{Contradicts Edge:}
}`\texttt{
σ(contradicts) = semantic\_similarity(C1, C2) × stance\_difference(C1, C2)
}`\texttt{
Where:
\item }semantic\_similarity\texttt{: Embedding cosine similarity
\item }stance\_difference\texttt{: Binary (0=same stance, 1=opposite stance)

\textbf{Derives Edge:}
}`\texttt{
σ(derives) = confidence(derivation) × completeness(inputs)
}`\texttt{
Where:
\item }confidence(derivation)\texttt{: VIF confidence of derivation process
\item }completeness(inputs)\texttt{: Fraction of required inputs present

\textbf{Confidence Propagation:}

Claim confidence aggregates from supporting edges:
}`\texttt{
confidence(claim) = Σ σ(supports\_i) × confidence(source\_i) / Σ σ(supports\_i)
}`\texttt{

Contradictions reduce confidence:
}`\texttt{
confidence(claim) = confidence(claim) × (1 - max(σ(contradicts\_j)))
}`\texttt{

\textbf{Consistency Checks:}

\textbf{A1: Anchoring Requirement:}
\item Every claim must have at least one source anchor
\item Validation: }∀c ∈ C: ∃s ∈ S: (s, c) ∈ E\_supports\texttt{
\item Failure: Dangling claim → reject release, require anchor

\textbf{A2: Contradiction Resolution:}
\item Contradicting claims receive remediation tasks
\item Detection: }∃c1, c2 ∈ C: (c1, c2) ∈ E\_contradicts\texttt{
\item Action: Create remediation task, escalate to reviewers

\textbf{A3: Temporal Consistency:}
\item Valid time intervals respect causality
\item Check: }valid\_from(derived) ≥ max(valid\_from(inputs))\texttt{
\item Failure: Temporal inconsistency → flag for review

\textbf{Graph Traversal Algorithms:}

\textbf{Impact Analysis:}
\item Question: "Which claims break if anchor expires?"
\item Algorithm: Reverse BFS from anchor to all supported claims
\item Formula: }impact(anchor) = Σ confidence(claim\_i)\texttt{ for all claims reachable from anchor

\textbf{Lineage Tracing:}
\item Question: "Where did this claim come from?"
\item Algorithm: Forward DFS from claim to all sources
\item Result: Complete provenance chain with confidence propagation

\subsection*{Graph Operations \& Algorithms}

\subsubsection*{Graph Construction}

\textbf{Node Creation:}
\item Claims created via SEG API with content, confidence, timestamps
\item Sources linked via VIF witnesses or document references
\item Derivations created from APOE execution traces
\item Agents registered via Authority system

\textbf{Edge Creation:}
\item Supports edges: Created when source anchors claim
\item Contradicts edges: Detected via semantic similarity + stance analysis
\item Derives edges: Created from APOE derivation chains
\item Witnesses edges: Created from VIF witness envelopes
\item Cites edges: Created from citation references

\textbf{Graph Updates:}
\item Incremental updates preserve graph consistency
\item Bitemporal tracking enables graph state queries
\item Updates validated against axioms before commit
\item Failed validations trigger remediation tasks

\textbf{Key Insight:} Graph construction ensures consistency through axiom validation and bitemporal tracking.

\subsubsection*{Graph Query Operations}

\textbf{Node Queries:}
\item \textbf{By Tag:} Query nodes by NL tags (fast tag index lookup)
\item \textbf{By Time:} Query nodes by transaction time or valid time (bitemporal queries)
\item \textbf{By Persona:} Query nodes by agent attribution (persona index)
\item \textbf{By Confidence:} Query nodes by confidence threshold (confidence-weighted traversal)

\textbf{Edge Queries:}
\item \textbf{Supports Chain:} Find all sources supporting a claim (forward traversal)
\item \textbf{Impact Analysis:} Find all claims impacted by source expiration (reverse traversal)
\item \textbf{Lineage Trace:} Find complete provenance chain for claim (forward DFS)
\item \textbf{Contradiction Detection:} Find all contradicting claims (contradicts edge queries)

\textbf{Graph Metrics:}
\item \textbf{Node Count:} Total nodes by type (Claims, Sources, Derivations, Agents)
\item \textbf{Edge Count:} Total edges by type (supports, contradicts, derives, witnesses, cites)
\item \textbf{Connectivity:} Average degree, clustering coefficient
\item \textbf{Confidence Distribution:} Confidence histogram across claims

\textbf{Key Insight:} Graph query operations enable efficient evidence retrieval and analysis.

\subsection*{Real-World Graph Operations}

\subsubsection*{Case Study: Evidence Chain Validation}

\textbf{Scenario:} Validate evidence chain for critical claim.

\textbf{Process:}
1. \textbf{Query Claim:} Retrieve claim from SEG by ID
   - Claim: "HHNI retrieval achieves p95 < 80ms latency"
   - Confidence: 0.92
   - Created: 2025-11-01
2. \textbf{Trace Lineage:} Forward DFS from claim to all sources
   - Derivation: APOE execution trace (confidence: 0.90)
   - Source 1: Benchmark results (Tier A, confidence: 0.95)
   - Source 2: Production metrics (Tier A, confidence: 0.93)
   - Source 3: VIF witness (confidence: 0.88)
3. \textbf{Validate Anchoring:} Check A1 axiom (every claim has source anchor)
   - 3 sources found ✅
   - All sources Tier A ✅
   - Anchoring requirement satisfied ✅
4. \textbf{Check Contradictions:} Query contradicts edges
   - No contradictions found ✅
   - Confidence validated ✅
5. \textbf{Impact Analysis:} Reverse BFS to find dependent claims
   - 5 dependent claims found
   - Impact score: 4.2 (sum of dependent claim confidences)

\textbf{Outcome:} Evidence chain validated successfully with complete provenance, no contradictions, high confidence.

\textbf{Metrics:}
\item \textbf{Lineage Depth:} 3 levels (claim → derivation → sources)
\item \textbf{Source Count:} 3 sources (all Tier A)
\item \textbf{Contradictions:} 0 ✅
\item \textbf{Dependent Claims:} 5 claims
\item \textbf{Validation Time:} <2 seconds

\textbf{Key Learnings:}
\item Lineage tracing enables complete provenance validation
\item Anchoring validation ensures evidence quality
\item Contradiction detection prevents inconsistent claims
\item Impact analysis identifies dependent claims

\subsubsection*{Case Study: Contradiction Detection \& Resolution}

\textbf{Scenario:} Detect and resolve contradicting claims.

\textbf{Process:}
1. \textbf{Detection:} Semantic similarity + stance analysis detects contradiction
   - Claim 1: "HHNI retrieval latency is <80ms" (confidence: 0.92)
   - Claim 2: "HHNI retrieval latency is >100ms" (confidence: 0.85)
   - Similarity: 0.95 (high semantic similarity)
   - Stance: Opposite (contradiction detected)
2. \textbf{Contradiction Edge:} Create contradicts edge between claims
   - Edge strength: σ(contradicts) = 0.95 × 1.0 = 0.95
   - Confidence reduction: Both claims reduced by 0.95
   - Claim 1 confidence: 0.92 → 0.05
   - Claim 2 confidence: 0.85 → 0.04
3. \textbf{Remediation:} SIS creates remediation task
   - Task: Investigate contradiction, validate correct claim
   - Owner: Evidence team
   - Deadline: 24 hours
4. \textbf{Resolution:} Evidence team validates Claim 1, invalidates Claim 2
   - Claim 1: Validated (confidence restored to 0.92)
   - Claim 2: Retired (confidence set to 0.0)
   - Contradiction edge: Removed
   - Remediation task: Closed

\textbf{Outcome:} Contradiction detected, remediated, and resolved with correct claim validated.

\textbf{Metrics:}
\item \textbf{Detection Time:} <1 second (automated)
\item \textbf{Remediation Time:} 18 hours (target: <24 hours) ✅
\item \textbf{Resolution:} Correct claim validated ✅
\item \textbf{Confidence Impact:} Temporary reduction, then restoration

\textbf{Key Learnings:}
\item Automated contradiction detection prevents inconsistent claims
\item Confidence reduction penalizes contradictions
\item Remediation enables systematic resolution
\item Validation restores correct claim confidence

\subsection*{Graph Troubleshooting Guide}

\subsubsection*{Issue: Dangling Claims}

\textbf{Symptoms:}
\item Claims without source anchors
\item A1 axiom validation failures
\item Claims rejected during release

\textbf{Diagnosis:}
1. Query claims without supports edges
2. Check source creation logs
3. Verify VIF witness linking
4. Review APOE execution traces

\textbf{Resolution:}
1. Create missing source anchors
2. Link sources to claims via supports edges
3. Re-run A1 validation
4. Update claim status

\textbf{Prevention:}
\item Pre-commit anchoring checks
\item Automated source linking
\item Continuous A1 validation

\subsubsection*{Issue: Contradiction Cascade}

\textbf{Symptoms:}
\item Multiple contradicting claims detected
\item Confidence degradation across claims
\item Remediation tasks accumulating

\textbf{Diagnosis:}
1. Query contradicts edges
2. Identify contradiction clusters
3. Trace contradiction sources
4. Review evidence quality

\textbf{Resolution:}
1. Validate correct claims
2. Retire incorrect claims
3. Remove contradiction edges
4. Restore confidence scores

\textbf{Prevention:}
\item Evidence quality validation
\item Pre-commit contradiction checks
\item Automated contradiction detection

\subsubsection*{Issue: Temporal Inconsistency}

\textbf{Symptoms:}
\item A3 axiom validation failures
\item Derived claims with invalid timestamps
\item Temporal queries returning inconsistent results

\textbf{Diagnosis:}
1. Check valid\_time intervals
2. Verify derivation timestamps
3. Review input claim timestamps
4. Validate temporal causality

\textbf{Resolution:}
1. Correct invalid timestamps
2. Update valid\_time intervals
3. Re-run A3 validation
4. Fix temporal queries

\textbf{Prevention:}
\item Temporal consistency checks
\item Automated timestamp validation
\item Continuous A3 monitoring
